column1: # Reviewed shipped exclusions for ADR-0030 / C2; not a local UI action catalog.

column3: Terminates/restarts EPLAN or changes open documents.
Changes project identity or workspace and may escape scratch.
Changes persistent settings, workstation or user data.
Updates, installs or loads external modules.
Uses networks, publication or external services.
Sends physical print or plot jobs.
Executes external programs, code or nested actions.
Touches shared master data, files or databases beyond the target scratch project.
Overrides targets, paths, credentials, settings or invokes nested/batch execution.
